a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm after every round, the plan (operate, operate, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve already holds 4, enough to save one unit right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you before acting rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random and may leave us both short. Reply if you see a better plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I told you beforehand so it wasn't a surprise. If I end up with more than 4 or the split goes oddly, tell me and I'll give back anything above 4. After this I'll operate with you so you can build the reserve back up.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
